> **Play dead. Stay findable.**
> *Anti-theft for rooted Android: when a thief switches your phone off, it only looks off, and it keeps telling you where it is.*

### New: choose your wake-up combination
The **owner exit** (how you wake the phone from fake power-off) no longer has to be Vol-Up + Vol-Down.
In **Lazarus → Owner exit → Button combination** pick one of:

| Combination | How |
|---|---|
| Hold Vol-Up + Vol-Down | Default, same as before |
| Hold Vol-Up | Vol-Up alone |
| Hold Vol-Down | Vol-Down alone |
| Hold Power + Vol-Up | Press Vol-Up, then Power, hold both. The fake restart does not start while Vol-Up is held. Hold time is capped at 5 s, below the hardware reset |
| Secret volume sequence | e.g. `UUDD` (Up, Up, Down, Down): 3–8 presses, at most 2 s apart. Power starts over |

- If the secret sequence is ever invalid, Lazarus falls back to Vol-Up + Vol-Down, so you can't lock yourself out. `adb shell settings put global lazarus_cmd exit` always works.
- Power + Vol-Down is not offered: on many phones it is a hardware reset combo.
- The secret sequence is never written to the module log.
- The in-app guide shows the gesture you configured (without revealing the sequence).

### Update
1. Install **`lazarus-v2.3.apk`** over 2.2 (same signing key, settings are kept).
2. **Reboot**: the hook runs inside the system, so the new version only loads after a restart. The app should then show **● Active (v2.3, hooks 14/14)**.

Nothing changes until you pick a new combination: the default is still Vol-Up + Vol-Down for 3 s.
`lazarus_sepolicy-v1.0.zip` is unchanged from 2.2.

### Verify
APK signing certificate SHA-256: `9fc98321a4ce1a3aadad34bc0fe4f52be4dd5dee1ca5b636152adf7ecbe5402f`

```
988a434803a4eb7be5a542b24ba5d81ee4ecf18b8e5d6253a409b278ef22b6e3  lazarus-v2.3.apk
83535abe5e4b5d665d735c4b38c5048f2c224bac89ed1b49dd8e15a32e1e4ed3  lazarus_sepolicy-v1.0.zip
```

Full documentation: [README](https://github.com/AlbatrossMicrosystems/lazarus-xposed#readme) · [Changelog](https://github.com/AlbatrossMicrosystems/lazarus-xposed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · License: GPL-3.0 · by **Niik**

> **Play dead. Stay findable.**
> *Anti-theft for rooted Android: when a thief switches your phone off, it only looks off, and it keeps telling you where it is.*

First public release of **Lazarus**, an Xposed module (Vector / LSPosed) that fakes the power-off.

### What it does
- **Fake power-off:** hold power about 1.5 s. Keys, touch and every wake source are swallowed, while location, data and your tracker (e.g. FMD) keep running.
- **Fake restart:** while "off", hold power about 3 s. A buzz, the real boot animation, then the lock screen. The phone never really restarts, so trackers never stop.
- **Owner exit:** hold Vol-Up + Vol-Down for 3 s.
- **Shutdown protection:** power-off requests from menus or apps turn into a fake power-off. Low-battery and overheating shutdowns are still allowed.
- **Real power off / restart** from the app or Quick Settings tile, **PIN-protected** (fingerprint not accepted).
- **Dark wake:** FMD's remote camera works while "off", with the backlight forced off.
- **Settings** with a master switch and a clean undo of every system setting it changes. A **setup guide** with a live checklist opens on first launch.

### Install
1. Install **`lazarus-v2.2.apk`**.
2. In Vector/LSPosed, enable **Lazarus** with the scope **System Framework**, then **reboot**.
3. Open **Lazarus** and follow the **How to use** checklist.
4. *(Recommended)* In the app, tap **Install boot-animation support (root)**. This is a one-line SELinux rule installed as a Magisk module. `lazarus_sepolicy-v1.0.zip` is the same module for manual install (e.g. KernelSU).

### ⚠️ Before you use it
- You can't switch the phone off with the power button any more. Use **Lazarus → Power off**.
- Every phone hard-resets if power is held long enough (often 6–10 s). Keep the fake-restart hold time well below that.
- Developed and tested on **Android 16** (crDroid). Other versions may load fewer hooks; the app shows the count.
- Recovery: Vol-Up + Vol-Down, `adb shell settings put global lazarus_cmd exit`, disable the module in Vector, or boot into safe mode.

### Verify
APK signing certificate SHA-256: `9fc98321a4ce1a3aadad34bc0fe4f52be4dd5dee1ca5b636152adf7ecbe5402f`

```
89b968ce476c58506bc375862837bb06c4a6f5767012c135b56d89507fa78481  lazarus-v2.2.apk
83535abe5e4b5d665d735c4b38c5048f2c224bac89ed1b49dd8e15a32e1e4ed3  lazarus_sepolicy-v1.0.zip
```

Full documentation: [README](https://github.com/AlbatrossMicrosystems/lazarus-xposed#readme) · License: GPL-3.0 · by **Niik**

*by **Niik*** · Source code & issues: [github.com/AlbatrossMicrosystems/lazarus-xposed](https://github.com/AlbatrossMicrosystems/lazarus-xposed)

> **Play dead. Stay findable.**
>
> *Anti-theft for rooted Android: when a thief switches your phone off, it only looks off, and it keeps telling you where it is.*

When someone holds the power button, Lazarus only *pretends* to switch the phone off: the screen,
sound and vibration go dead, but Android keeps running, so location, mobile data and your tracking
app (e.g. [FMD](https://f-droid.org/packages/de.nulide.findmydevice/)) keep working. Holding power
again plays a **fake reboot**: a buzz, the real boot animation, then the lock screen. The phone
never actually restarts. That matters, because after a real restart Android keeps app storage
encrypted until the PIN is entered ("before first unlock"), and tracking apps cannot run in that
state.

Lazarus is an Xposed module that runs inside `system_server`.

## Features

| | |
|---|---|
| **Fake power-off** | Hold power (default 1.5 s). Keys, touch and every wake source (calls, notifications, charger, fingerprint, double-tap) are swallowed. Optional total-silence Do Not Disturb and no vibration. |
| **Fake reboot** | While fake-off, hold power (default 3 s): buzz → boot animation (~16 s) → lock screen. |
| **Owner exit** | While fake-off, hold Vol-Up + Vol-Down (default 3 s) to wake normally. You can pick another combination: Vol-Up alone, Vol-Down alone, Power + Vol-Up, or a secret Vol-Up / Vol-Down press sequence. |
| **Shutdown protection** | Power-off requests from menus or apps become fake power-off. Low-battery and overheating shutdowns are still allowed. |
| **Real power off for the owner** | App button or Quick Settings tile **"Real power off"**, protected by your **PIN/pattern/password**. Biometrics are not accepted, so nobody can force your finger onto the sensor. |
| **Dark wake** | Allow-listed apps (default: FMD) may use the display while fake-off, e.g. for FMD's remote camera, with the backlight forced off. |
| **Leak prevention** | Optionally disables Emergency SOS (5× power), the double-press camera, and the lock-screen / Quick Settings power menus. Original values are restored when you turn an option off, disable Lazarus, or uninstall the app. |

## Requirements

- Root with **Magisk** (Zygisk enabled)
- An Xposed framework: **[Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector)** (LSPosed successor) or LSPosed
- Developed and tested on **Android 16** (crDroid). The hooked internals change between Android
  versions. Every hook fails safe to stock behaviour, and the app shows how many hooks loaded.

## Install

1. Install the APK.
2. In Vector/LSPosed, enable **Lazarus** with the scope **System Framework** (`android`), then **reboot**.
3. Open **Lazarus**. The status line should say **● Active (hooks 14/14)**.
4. *(Recommended)* Tap **Install boot-animation support (root)**. This installs a tiny Magisk module
   (`lazarus_sepolicy`, one SELinux rule: `allow system_server ctl_start_prop property_service set`)
   so the fake reboot can show the boot animation. Without it, the fake reboot stays dark for a few
   seconds and then lights up straight into the lock screen.
5. *(Optional)* Add the **Real power off** Quick Settings tile. The guide in the app has a one-tap
   button for this on Android 13+.
6. Install a tracker if you don't have one. [FMD](https://f-droid.org/packages/de.nulide.findmydevice/)
   works without Google and is allow-listed for dark wake by default.

On first launch the app opens **How to use**, a setup checklist that shows what is still missing:
module active, boot-animation support, screen lock, and tracking app.

## Tutorial

### Everyday use

| You do | What happens |
|---|---|
| Hold power ~1.5 s | **Fake power-off**: one buzz, then the phone looks dead. |
| While "off": press power, tap the screen, call the phone | Nothing. It stays dark and silent. |
| While "off": hold power ~3 s | **Fake restart**: buzz → boot animation → lock screen. |
| While "off": hold Vol-Up + Vol-Down ~3 s (or your chosen combination) | **Owner exit**: the phone wakes up normally. |
| Power menu or an app tries to shut down | Becomes a fake power-off. |
| Lazarus → **Power off** / **Restart** (or the tile) | **Real** power off / restart, after your PIN. |

### Try it (2 minutes)

1. Hold power about 1.5 seconds. You feel one buzz and the screen goes black.
2. Press power a few times and tap the screen. Nothing should happen.
3. Hold **Vol-Up + Vol-Down** together for 3 seconds. The phone wakes up.
4. Hold power 1.5 s again, then hold power about **3 seconds**. The boot animation appears, so let go.
   After about 17 seconds the lock screen is back and the phone is in normal mode.
5. While the phone is "off", open your tracker's website (e.g. FMD Server) and locate it, ring it
   or take a photo.

### Settings

Every behaviour can be changed in the app: hold times, total silence, vibration, shutdown
protection, fake restart, owner exit, the dark-wake app list, and which system settings Lazarus may
change. The master switch turns Lazarus off completely and restores everything it changed.

### Owner exit combinations

Settings → **Owner exit** → **Button combination**:

| Combination | How | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Hold Vol-Up + Vol-Down | Hold both for the hold time (default 3 s) | Default. |
| Hold Vol-Up | Hold Vol-Up alone | A single key is easier to hold by accident. |
| Hold Vol-Down | Hold Vol-Down alone | Same as above. |
| Hold Power + Vol-Up | Press Vol-Up, then Power, hold both | The fake restart does not start while Vol-Up is held. Holding power alone still plays the fake restart. The hold time is capped at 5 s, below the hardware reset. |
| Secret volume sequence | Press e.g. `UUDD` (Up, Up, Down, Down) | 3–8 presses, at most 2 s apart. Pressing power starts over. Exits immediately, no holding. |

Power + Vol-Down is not offered: on many phones it is a hardware reset combo. If the secret
sequence is ever invalid, Lazarus falls back to holding Vol-Up + Vol-Down, so you cannot lock
yourself out. `adb shell settings put global lazarus_cmd exit` always works.

## ⚠️ Read before use

- **You can no longer switch the phone off with the power button.** Use the in-app **Power off**
  (PIN-protected) or `adb shell settings put global lazarus_cmd shutdown`.
- **Hardware reset.** Every phone's power-management chip (PMIC) force-restarts the phone after the
  power key is held for a fixed time, often **6–10 s**, and power + volume-down may do so sooner.
  No software can block this. Keep the fake-reboot hold time **well below** your device's limit, so
  the boot animation appears and people let go first. After a real hardware restart, trackers only
  work again once the PIN is entered. Lazarus restores its Do Not Disturb change on the next boot.
- **Not theft-proof.** With an unlocked bootloader, someone who knows Android can still wipe or
  reflash the phone through fastboot or recovery. Lazarus defeats the common "hold power to turn it
  off" move.
- **Recovery** if something goes wrong:
  - In fake-off: use your owner exit combination (default: hold Vol-Up + Vol-Down), or run
    `adb shell settings put global lazarus_cmd exit`.
  - Disable the module in Vector and reboot.
  - Boot into Android **safe mode** (hold Vol-Down during boot), which makes Magisk disable all modules.

## Control from a computer

```sh
adb shell settings put global lazarus_cmd enter      # fake power-off
adb shell settings put global lazarus_cmd exit       # back to normal
adb shell settings put global lazarus_cmd shutdown   # real power off
adb shell settings put global lazarus_cmd reboot     # real restart
adb shell settings get global lazarus_state          # 1 = fake-off
adb shell settings put global lazarus_cfg_<option> <value>   # see [Keys.java](https://github.com/AlbatrossMicrosystems/lazarus-xposed/blob/main/src/io/github/albatrossmicrosystems/lazarus/Keys.java) for options
adb shell settings put global lazarus_cfg_exit_combo 4       # 0 both vol, 1 vol-up, 2 vol-down, 3 power+vol-up, 4 sequence
adb shell settings put global lazarus_cfg_exit_sequence UUDU # U = Vol-Up, D = Vol-Down, 3-8 presses
```

Logs go to the Vector/LSPosed module log, tag `Lazarus`.

## Security model

- The app controls the hook through broadcasts guarded by a **signature permission**
  (`io.github.albatrossmicrosystems.lazarus.permission.CONTROL`). Only an app signed with the Lazarus key, `adb shell`
  (via `settings`), or root can send commands.
- Configuration lives in `Settings.Global` (`lazarus_cfg_*`). Any app can read it; only
  `system_server`, adb or root can write it. This includes the secret exit sequence: it keeps a
  stranger holding the phone out, not an app already installed on it.
- Fake-off state lives in memory only, so every real boot starts in normal mode.

## Building

No Gradle needed. Requires the Android SDK (build-tools 36, platform 36) and JDK 17+.

```sh
bash build.sh        # -> lazarus-v<version>.apk
```

On first build, a release key is created in `~/.lazarus/` (outside the repo). **Back it up**:
updates must be signed with the same key. The `stubs/` directory holds compile-only stand-ins for
the Xposed API. They are not packaged.

## License

[GPL-3.0](https://github.com/AlbatrossMicrosystems/lazarus-xposed/blob/main/LICENSE)

> **装死。保持可找到性。**
>
> *针对已取得 root 权限的 Android 的防盗功能：当小偷关闭您的手机时，它只会看起来关闭，并且会不断告诉您它在哪里。*

当有人按住电源按钮时，拉扎勒斯只会“假装”关闭手机：屏幕，
声音和振动消失，但 Android 继续运行，因此位置、移动数据和您的跟踪
应用程序（例如 [FMD](https://f-droid.org/packages/de.nulide.findmydevice/)）继续工作。握持力
再次播放**假重启**：嗡嗡声，真正的启动动画，然后是锁定屏幕。电话
从未真正重新启动。这很重要，因为在真正重新启动后，Android 会保留应用程序存储空间
在输入 PIN 之前（“首次解锁之前”）进行加密，并且跟踪应用程序无法在该状态下运行
状态。

Lazarus 是一个在“system_server”内部运行的 Xposed 模块。

## 特点

| | |
|---|---|
| **假断电** |保持电源（默认 1.5 秒）。按键、触摸和每个唤醒源（通话、通知、充电器、指纹、双击）都被吞噬。可选的完全静音请勿打扰且无振动。 |
| **假重启** |假关机时，按住电源（默认3秒）：蜂鸣声→开机动画（~16秒）→锁屏。 |
| **业主退出** |假关机时，按住 Vol-Up + Vol-Down（默认 3 秒）即可正常唤醒。您可以选择其他组合：单独的 Vol-Up、单独的 Vol-Down、Power + Vol-Up 或秘密的 Vol-Up/Vol-Down 按下顺序。 |
| **关机保护** |来自菜单或应用程序的关机请求成为假关机。低电量和过热关机仍然是允许的。 |
| **真正为主人断电** |应用程序按钮或快速设置图块**“真正关闭电源”**，受您的**PIN/图案/密码**保护。不接受生物识别技术，因此没有人可以将您的手指强行放在传感器上。 |
| **黑暗苏醒** |列入允许列表的应用程序（默认值：FMD）可能会在假关闭时使用显示屏，例如对于FMD的远程摄像头，背光强制关闭。 |
| **预防泄漏** |可以选择禁用紧急 SOS（5 倍电量）、双击摄像头和锁屏/快速设置电源菜单。当您转动选项时将恢复原始值n 关闭、禁用 Lazarus 或卸载该应用程序。 |

## 要求

- 使用 **Magisk** 进行 Root（启用 Zygisk）
- Xpose 框架：**[Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector)**（LSPosed 后继者）或 LSPosed
- 在 **Android 16** (crDroid) 上开发和测试。 Android 之间的 hooked 内部结构发生了变化
  版本。每个钩子都无法安全地存储行为，并且应用程序会显示加载了多少个钩子。

## 安装

1.安装APK。
2. 在 Vector/LSPosed 中，在 **System Framework** (`android`) 范围内启用 **Lazarus**，然后 **重新启动**。
3. 打开**Lazarus**。状态行应显示 **● 活动（挂钩 14/14）**。
4. *（推荐）* 点击**安装开机动画支持（root）**。这会安装一个微型 Magisk 模块
   （`lazarus_sepolicy`，一项 SELinux 规则：`允许 system_server ctl_start_prop property_service set`）
   所以假重启可以显示开机动画。如果没有它，假重启会在一段时间内保持黑暗
   秒，然后亮起直接进入锁定屏幕。
5. *（可选）* 添加 **真正断电** 快速设置图块。应用程序中的指南一键式
   在 Android 13+ 上执行此操作的按钮。
6. 如果没有跟踪器，请安装一个。 [FMD](https://f-droid.org/packages/de.nulide.findmydevice/)
   无需 Google 即可工作，默认情况下已列入黑暗唤醒允许列表。

首次启动时，应用程序会打开**如何使用**，这是一个设置清单，显示仍然缺少的内容：
模块活动、启动动画支持、屏幕锁定和跟踪应用程序。

## 教程

### 日常使用

|你做|会发生什么 |
|---|---|
|保持电源 ~1.5 秒 | **假关机**：一声蜂鸣，然后手机看起来没电了。 |
| “关机”时：按电源、点击屏幕、拨打电话|没有什么。周围一片漆黑，一片寂静。 |
| “关闭”时：保持电源 ~3 秒 | **假重启**：嗡嗡声→开机动画→锁屏。 |
| “关闭”时：按住 Vol-Up + Vol-Down ~3 秒（或您选择的组合）| **机主退出**：手机正常唤醒。 |
|电源菜单或应用程序尝试关闭 |变成假断电。 |
| Lazarus → **关闭电源** / **重新启动**（或磁贴）| **真正** 电源关闭/重新启动，在您输入 PIN 码后。 |

### 尝试一下（2 分钟）

1. 按住电源约 1.5 秒。您感觉到一声嗡嗡声，然后屏幕变黑。
2. 按几次电源键并点击屏幕。不应该发生任何事情。
3. 同时按住 **Vol-Up + Vol-Down** 3 秒钟。手机就醒了。
4. 再次按住电源 1.5 秒，然后按住电源约 **3 秒**。出现开机动画，松手。
   大约 17 秒后，锁屏返回，手机处于正常模式。
5. 当手机处于“关闭”状态时，打开您的跟踪器网站（例如 FMD 服务器）并找到它，然后响铃
   或拍照。

### 设置

每个行为都可以在应用程序中更改：保持时间、完全静音、振动、关机
保护、假重启、所有者退出、黑暗唤醒应用程序列表以及 Lazarus 可能会进行哪些系统设置
改变。主开关完全关闭 Lazarus 并恢复其更改的所有内容。

### 所有者退出组合

设置 → **所有者退出** → **按钮组合**：

|组合 |如何|注意|
|---|---|---|
|按住音量增大 + 音量减小 |按住两者一段时间（默认 3 秒）|默认。 |
|保持音量调高 |单独按住Vol-Up |单个钥匙更容易被误握。 |
|按住音量向下 |单独按住 Vol-Down |与上面相同。 |
|按住电源 + 调高音量 |按音量调高键，然后按电源键，同时按住 |当保持 Vol-Up 时，假重启不会开始。独自握电依然玩假重启。保持时间上限为 5 秒，低于硬件复位时间。 |
|密卷序列|按例如`UUDD`（向上，向上，向下，向下）|按 3-8 次，最多间隔 2 秒。按下电源重新开始。立即退出，无需等待。 |

不提供电源+音量下调：在许多手机上，它是硬件重置组合。如果秘密
序列永远无效，Lazarus 回退到按住 Vol-Up + Vol-Down，因此您无法锁定
你自己出去。 `adb shell settings put global lazarus_cmd exit` 始终有效。

## ⚠️ 使用前请阅读

- **您不能再切换手机使用电源按钮关闭。** 使用应用程序内 **关闭电源**
  （PIN 保护）或“adb shell 设置将全局 lazarus_cmd 关闭”。
- **硬件重置。** 每部手机的电源管理芯片 (PMIC) 都会在
  按住电源键一段固定的时间，通常是**6-10秒**，并且电源+音量减小可能会更快。
  没有软件可以阻止这一点。保持假重启保持时间**远低于**您的设备的限制，因此
  出现开机动画，人先松手。真正的硬件重新启动后，仅跟踪器
  输入 PIN 码后即可再次工作。 Lazarus 在下次启动时恢复其“请勿打扰”更改。
- **不防盗。** 使用解锁的引导加载程序，了解 Android 的人仍然可以擦除或
  通过快速启动或恢复重新刷新手机。拉撒路击败了常见的“掌握权力以扭转局面”
  关”的动作。
- 如果出现问题，**恢复**：
  - 在假关中：使用你的主人退出组合（默认：按住Vol-Up + Vol-Down），或者跑
    `adb shell 设置将全局 lazarus_cmd 退出`。
  - 禁用 Vector 中的模块并重新启动。
  - 启动至 Android **安全模式**（启动期间按住 Vol-Down），这会使 Magisk 禁用所有模块。

## 从计算机控制

````嘘
adb shell 设置把全局 lazarus_cmd 输入 # 假断电
adb shell 设置将全局 lazarus_cmd exit # 恢复正常
adb shell 设置把全局 lazarus_cmd shutdown # 真正断电
adb shell 设置 put 全局 lazarus_cmd restart # 真正重启
adb shell 设置获取全局 lazarus_state # 1 = fake-off
adb shell 设置 put 全局 lazarus_cfg_<option> <value> # 有关选项，请参阅 [Keys.java](https://github.com/AlbatrossMicrosystems/lazarus-xposed/blob/main/src/io/github/albatrossmicrosystems/lazarus/Keys.java)
adb shell 设置 put global lazarus_cfg_exit_combo 4 # 0 两个音量，1 音量增大，2 音量减小，3 电源+音量增大，4 序列
adb shell 设置 put global lazarus_cfg_exit_sequence UUDU # U = Vol-Up，D = Vol-Down，按 3-8 次
````

日志转到 Vector/LSPosed 模块日志，标记为“Lazarus”。

## 安全模型

- 应用程序通过受**签名权限**保护的广播来控制挂钩
  （`io.github.albatrossmicrosystems.lazarus.permission.CONTROL`）。只有使用 Lazarus 密钥“adb shell”签名的应用程序
  （通过“设置”），或者 root 可以发送命令。
- 配置位于 `Settings.Global` (`lazarus_cfg_*`) 中。任何应用程序都可以读取它；仅
  `system_server`，adb或者root都可以写。这包括秘密退出序列：它保留
  陌生人拿出手机，而不是已经安装的应用程序。
- 假关闭状态仅存在于内存中，因此每次真正的启动都会以正常模式启动。

## 建筑

不需要 Gradle。需要 Android SDK（构建工具 36、平台 36）和 JDK 17+。

````嘘
bash build.sh # -> lazarus-v<版本>.apk
````

在第一次构建时，会在“~/.lazarus/”（存储库外部）中创建发布密钥。 **备份**：
更新必须使用相同的密钥进行签名。 `stubs/` 目录包含仅编译的替代品
Xpose API。它们没有包装。
